## 3dslibris 3.2.0

This update adds selectable control schemes, including a one-handed preset, and fixes opening books from library search and the reader status bar colours after resetting settings.

### New

- [#183](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/183): control schemes. The settings `controls (vertical)` and `controls (horizontal)` each choose between `Default` and `One-handed`, so portrait and landscape can use different schemes. In `One-handed`, a tap on D-Pad Left (vertical) or D-Pad Up (horizontal) toggles the bookmark, and holding it enters link and image selection. While selecting, the D-Pad moves the selection and D-Pad Right (vertical) or D-Pad Down (horizontal) opens the selected link or image. L and R leave the selection, and bookmark jumps move to the Circle Pad.

### Fixes and improvements

- Library search: tapping or pressing A on an EPUB, MOBI or FB2 result now opens the book instead of showing "Unable to open result".
- Settings: `reset settings` now also resets the colour theme everywhere. Previously, if a theme such as sepia had been active, the reader kept the old background while the bottom status bar turned white with black text.
- Library: tapping a book or folder now opens it right away instead of needing a second tap. Touch and hold a cell to select it and see its full title on the top screen without opening it; dragging off the cell cancels.
- Layout: long titles and paths no longer run past their boxes. Settings rows keep both lines inside the border, search results, the chapter index, book information and font file names wrap their full text and grow or paginate to fit, the library list shows up to three lines per title, and the selected list row scrolls its title when it still does not fit.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone trying the builds and reporting issues. You can support the project with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
